title: End-of-life for legacy 'embed-bundle' transactional endpoints — migration plan and acceptance criteria
creator: Maya Rodriguez
description: PRD: We will retire the legacy synchronous transactional endpoint set historically exposed as /v1/embed-bundle ("transactional embed bundles"). These endpoints bundle many embedding requests into a single transactional call and return a combined payload. Operationally they block on backfill/aggregation, bypass newer bulk multiplexing paths, and have caused recurring tail-latency and cost attribution issues. The replacement is bulk-embeddings-v1, an async-first, per-item receipt model with batch-multiplexing, per-item idempotency tokens, and explicit polling/webhook completion semantics. This ticket defines the scope, acceptance criteria, rollout timeline, SDK/CLI adapter requirements, telemetry gates, and support runbook for a safe deprecation.
acceptance_criteria: SDKs (python, js, go) publish adapter functions that transparently rewrite /v1/embed-bundle calls to bulk-embeddings-v1 async flow and are available in docs and package registries
Migration CLI (embed-migrate) available as beta that scans callsites, flags unsupported payload shapes, and can perform tokenized rewrite in client repos
Console shows a migration status tile (per-customer) that surfaces remaining embed-bundle traffic and estimated cost delta

Telemetry gates: <=0.5% increase in 99th p90 latency for active customers during pilot; error rate for migrated flows <1% over 72h; adoption >60% of embed-bundle traffic across opt-in pilot accounts before hard cut
Support playbook and runbook published and reachable from the deprecation notice; SLOs for fallback behaviors documented
Backward-compatibility shim (hosted) available to opt-in customers for a 90-day bridge window; shim limited to 10k reqs/day/customer and logs deprecation telemetry
Documentation and migration guide published with examples for common patterns: batched ids, metadata passthrough, embedding-dedup semantics
Legal & billing updates completed so customers see clear billing mapping from bundled transactions to per-item units
migration_steps: Day 0: Announce deprecation via email, console banner, and support channels with 90-day migration window
Week 1-2: Release SDK adapters (alpha) + migration guide with code examples and recommended idempotency practices
Week 3-5: Pilot with 10 strategic customers; enable hosted compatibility shim for pilot participants; collect telemetry and breakage reports
Week 6-8: Release migration CLI v1.0 and automated refactor examples; open-source small helper library for server-side adapters
Week 9-12: Widen rollout to public opt-in; console migration tile enables auto-enroll for low-traffic customers; monitor telemetry gates daily
Week 13: Begin gated hard cut for non-opted-in accounts where traffic < threshold and telemetry gates satisfied; continue shim for enterprise customers on case-by-case SLA
Day 90: Disable legacy transactional endpoints for all non-exempt customers; move remaining customers to enterprise migration plan
rollout_phases: Phase C (Public Opt-in & CLI GA): 2026-02-24 to 2026-03-31
Phase D (Gated Cut & Enterprise Migration): 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30
telemetry_signals: per-customer embed-bundle request volume (RPS and daily counts)
ratio of embed-bundle calls rewritten by SDK adapter / CLI
error-rate and 95/99/999 latency for rewritten flows vs legacy
percentage of successful idempotent retries (indicating correct token use)
billing unit delta (tokens billed per-embedding before vs after)
shim-usage counts and throttled requests per-customer
rollback_plan: If a critical regression is detected during any phase (error rate >5% sustained for 1 hour or p99 latency spike >50% relative baseline), pause the rollout, rollback SDK adapter release, re-enable hosted shim for affected customers, open an incident with infra and runtime teams, and run targeted rollback playbooks. For hard-cut scenarios we will re-provision a temporary compatibility gateway for impacted customers while patching their migration defects.
support_runbook: How to triage: check console migration tile for customer state and shim activity
Escalation matrix: Support -> Solutions Eng -> Runtime Infra -> Product
Common issues and fixes: missing idempotency token, oversized bundle payloads, metadata schema mismatches
Mitigations: enable hosted shim, advise SDK adapter install, request temporary quota bump for migration window
